name: Tailcat Unauthenticated SSH Server Execution
description: Detects 'tailcat serve no-auth-ssh' execution — an unauthenticated SSH shell exposed over a WireGuard-encrypted tunnel through Tailscale DERP internet relays. Core Kothamine C2 listener behavior with essentially no legitimate enterprise use.
query: process where process.name : ("tailcat.exe", "tailcat") and process.args : "serve" and process.args : "no-auth-ssh"
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Tailcat Binary Execution from Non-Standard Path
description: Detects tailcat execution from user-writable or temporary locations (Temp, AppData, Public, Downloads, ProgramData, /tmp, /var/tmp, /dev/shm, /home). Kothamine fetches the tailcat binary from GitHub releases at runtime and executes it in place (T1105 ingress tool transfer).
query: process where process.name : ("tailcat.exe", "tailcat") and (process.executable : ("*\\Temp\\*", "*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\ProgramData\\*", "*\\Downloads\\*", "/tmp/*", "/var/tmp/*", "/dev/shm/*", "/home/*") or process.working_directory : ("*\\Temp\\*", "*\\AppData\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "/tmp/*", "/var/tmp/*", "/dev/shm/*"))
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Tailcat Spawning SSH or SCP ProxyCommand Child Process
description: Detects ssh/scp/sftp spawned as children of a tailcat process. tailcat drives the system OpenSSH clients via ProxyCommand for its ssh and cp subcommands, making this parent-child chain inherent to the tunneling and exfiltration technique regardless of tooling version.
query:
sequence by host.id, process.parent.entity_id
  [process where process.name : ("tailcat.exe", "tailcat")]
  [process where process.name : ("ssh.exe", "scp.exe", "sftp.exe", "ssh", "scp", "sftp") and process.parent.name : ("tailcat.exe", "tailcat")]
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: DNS Query to Tailscale DERP Relay or Tailcat Infrastructure
description: Detects DNS lookups for Tailscale DERP relay infrastructure (derp*.tailscale.com, *.ipn.dev) or the tailcat DERP-map endpoint (tailcat.dev) by a host with no sanctioned Tailscale deployment — the highest-fidelity network signal of Kothamine encrypted C2 tunneling.
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Tailcat File Transfer Over Encrypted C2 Channel
description: Detects 'tailcat cp' or 'tailcat recv' — scp/SFTP-style file transfers routed through the WireGuard/DERP tunnel. Kothamine stages a drop-box receiver and exfiltrates collected data over this encrypted C2 channel.
query: process where process.name : ("tailcat.exe", "tailcat") and (process.args : "cp" or process.args : "recv")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
